correctness_confidence.basis: All 18 Lean 4 theorems in lean/PolytopeDiameter.lean are verified with 0 sorry and 0 Classical.choice. Pure-stdlib Python verifier (POLYTOPE-DIAM-CERT-1.0) successfully replays all 16 exact-Q certificates with zero floats and rejects all 52/52 adversarial red-teaming attacks.

novelty.basis: First machine-checked zero-dependency certification framework and exact-Q verifier for OpenAI's disproof of the polynomial Hirsch conjecture, projective packing isomorphisms, and s-move lower bounds.

reproducibility.basis: Complete exact-Q certificates (16 instances), deterministic Python verification scripts, zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel, and comprehensive test suites provided with open-source MIT license.

rigor.basis: Rigorous exact rational arithmetic over Q avoiding floating-point degeneracy, complete formalization of d-regular vertex completeness, projective doubly-stochastic packing maps, and cell superadditivity.

significance.basis: Bridges cutting-edge polytope-diameter geometry with machine-checked Lean 4 formal verification and exact-Q reproducibility, establishing foundational certifiability for major complexity separations in linear programming.

potential_errors: Scope boundary: Mode 1 vertex-completeness check scales with |V(P)| (MAX_VERTICES = 256), making it suitable for small-to-medium explicit rational polytopes rather than full asymptotic clock-scheduler constructions.
strengths: Zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings) providing ironclad formal verification of 18 core algebraic and combinatorial theorems.
Pure-stdlib exact-Q Python verifier (POLYTOPE-DIAM-CERT-1.0) executing zero-float arithmetic across 16 diverse certificate instances in 0.08–10.64 ms.
Comprehensive adversarial red-teaming suite subjecting the verifier to 52 distinct attacks and rejecting all successfully.
Clear mathematical exposition linking d-regular simple-vertex witness sandwiches, fold-bending obstructions, and projective doubly-stochastic packing isomorphisms.
strong_novelty_candidates: Machine-checked exact-Q certification of projective doubly-stochastic packing isomorphisms (Corollary 14.3) and s-move diameter lower bounds.
POLYTOPE-DIAM-CERT-1.0 zero-float exact rational verification architecture with rigorous adversarial rejection testing.
summary: The manuscript presents a rigorous, machine-checked exact-Q certification framework (POLYTOPE-DIAM-CERT-1.0 and zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel) for OpenAI's recent disproof of the polynomial Hirsch conjecture. Through 18 formal theorems and 16 verified exact-Q certificates spanning s-move diameter sandwiches, fold-bending cell superadditivity, projective doubly-stochastic packing isomorphisms, and Klee-Minty separations, the authors establish an unassailable foundation of exact rational reproducibility and adversarial robustness.
weaknesses: Discussion of scalability limits is somewhat brief, though appropriately bounded to small-to-medium explicit polytopes and prismatoids.
